More than roofing CRM

Find the opportunity, organize the sales effort, and carry the job through to materials

RoofSpan goes past job tracking — three capabilities set it apart from a generic roofing CRM.

Know the property before you knock

Bring property records onto the map with owner information, address, property type, year built and square footage where available, and owner-occupied / non-owner-occupied status — tied directly into RoofSpan.

Available property and ownership information varies by source and location.

Turn neighborhoods into organized sales territories

Put properties on the map, draw territories and smaller canvass sections, see which properties fall inside each section, catch assignment overlaps, respect Do-Not-Knock properties, and assign sections to salespeople — who then see their area in RoofSpan Mobile.

Data & security

Your operation runs on a system you control

RoofSpan is built around two clearly separate pieces. Here's how they fit together.

RoofSpan Office

Installs and runs on your company's own Windows machine. Your operational PostgreSQL roofing database lives with your installation.

RoofSpan Mobile

Free companion apps that securely pair with your Office installation so field crews can work while away from the office.

FAQ

Common questions

Can RoofSpan help us find properties to canvass?

Yes. RoofSpan brings property records onto the map with owner information, property type, year built and square footage where available, so you can see and organize the properties worth working.

Can I assign neighborhoods to individual salespeople?

Yes. In RoofSpan Office you draw territories and smaller canvass sections, see which properties fall inside each, resolve assignment overlaps, and assign sections to specific salespeople.

What does a salesperson see in RoofSpan Mobile?

Each salesperson opens My Area to see their assigned canvass section — a property map, owner and occupancy context, Do-Not-Knock properties, visit outcomes, photos and inspections, and the leads and jobs tied to their work.

Does RoofSpan integrate with ABC Supply?

Yes. Connect your ABC Supply account to browse the catalog, add products to RoofSpan inventory, retrieve account-specific pricing, build purchase orders, place orders, and review order history and templates.

Can RoofSpan show property ownership information?

RoofSpan can surface owner information and whether a property is owner-occupied or non-owner-occupied. Available property and ownership information varies by source and location.

What do I need to run RoofSpan Office?

RoofSpan Office installs and runs on your company's own Windows computer and opens through a local browser interface. There is no separate hosted web application to log into.

How does RoofSpan Mobile connect?

Field users install the free RoofSpan Mobile app and pair it with your company's RoofSpan Office installation. Mobile is built for the field, with locally cached data and queued updates that synchronize back to Office when connectivity is available.

How much does RoofSpan cost?

RoofSpan is $49 per user per month with a five-user minimum, so pricing starts at $245 per month. RoofSpan Mobile is included at no extra cost.

Where does my data live?

Your operational roofing database lives with your RoofSpan Office installation on your company's own Windows system.
